question: Which chess player, besides Gukesh, received the Arjuna Award in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vantika Agrawal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vantika Agrawal**, a talented and emerging chess player from India, was awarded the prestigious **Arjuna Award in 2025** along with Gukesh.
 
• The **Arjuna Award** is conferred by the Government of India to recognize outstanding achievement in national sports. It is one of the highest civilian honors for sports in the country.
 
• **Vantika Agrawal** has made remarkable contributions to Indian chess, especially in international competitions, by consistently performing well in individual and team events.
 
• She has represented India in several prestigious tournaments, including **Chess Olympiads** and the **Asian Games**, showcasing her strategic brilliance and sharp tactical skills.
 
• The Arjuna Award recognizes not just her exceptional talent but also her dedication, discipline, and determination, which have inspired many young chess players in the country.

__
 
• **Arjuna Award:**

 
 
• The **Arjuna Award** was instituted in **1961** by the Government of India to honor exceptional athletes in various sports disciplines.
 
• It includes a **bronze statuette of Arjuna**, a certificate, ceremonial dress, and a **cash award**.
 
• The award aims to recognize consistent performance over a period of four years and qualities like leadership, sportsmanship, and discipline.
 
 
 
• **About Vantika Agrawal:**
 
 
• Vantika Agrawal is a rising star in Indian chess, known for her **aggressive playing style** and exceptional problem-solving skills.
 
• She has won numerous accolades, including medals in **national and international chess tournaments**.
 
• She is also a role model for young chess enthusiasts, encouraging more participation in the sport, especially among young girls in India.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Chess Players:**
 
 
• **Koneru Humpy:** A legendary Indian chess player and the second woman to achieve the Grandmaster title. She has been awarded the **Padma Shri** and the Arjuna Award.
 
• **Harika Dronavalli:** Another prominent Indian chess player who has won multiple medals in international tournaments, including the Chess Olympiad.
 
• **Pentala Harikrishna:** One of the top male chess players in India, known for his exceptional endgame skills and consistency in international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Chess and India:**
 
 
• India has a rich history in chess, with legends like **Viswanathan Anand** putting Indian chess on the global map.
 
• In recent years, young players like **Gukesh**, **Praggnanandhaa**, and **Vantika Agrawal** have emerged as strong contenders in global chess events.
 
• India has also hosted several international chess tournaments, further promoting the sport.
